verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no bulk export, data portability, or offboarding feature for Flagright. The only related material is REST read endpoints that return JSON (e.g. GET a consumer user, get cases, get alerts). These are developer building blocks someone could use to construct an export, not a documented 'export all my data and leave' capability, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
